description: This file defines a PHP controller class 'RequestPasswordSuccessController' in the OrangeHRM project, responsible for handling the UI flow after a successful password reset request. It extends a base controller and implements a public interface, setting up a Vue component and a template for the view.

classes.name: RequestPasswordSuccessController
classes.description: Controller handling the display after a successful password reset request, setting a Vue component and rendering a template.
